title: The Lame Goat
offer: My best goat, Hedda, limps! A thorn, I think, but she won't let me look. Take her to Tova on Laxön. She takes the room of a crate, and she butts!

steps.say: Hold her head, gently... There: a big thorn. Leave her with me tonight, with a herb wrap.

steps.load_say: She walks well again. Take her home!
steps.say: Hedda! She jumps like a kid again. Here, the best cheese I have.

fact: Goats climb anything: rocks, roofs, and sometimes boats.
